en.name: aoof.ca
en.summary: This site. SvelteKit in a Docker container, redeployed by GitHub Actions on every push.
en.description:
I built and maintain this portfolio in SvelteKit and TypeScript, with over 145 commits since June 2024.

It runs in a Docker container on my own Linux server on Hetzner, and a GitHub Actions workflow redeploys it over SSH on every push. I set up Sveltia CMS at /admin so I can edit content without touching code. Those edits are committed to the repository and deployed automatically.

J'ai créé et je maintiens ce portfolio en SvelteKit et TypeScript, avec plus de 145 commits depuis juin 2024.
